mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the federal funds rate increased by more than 0.5% within the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.2 percentage points within the last month signals a strengthening labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and business investment increase.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the unemployment rate decreased by more than 0.2 percentage points within the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP by more than 2% year-over-year signals strong economic growth, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 50% of the instances where real GDP increased by more than 2% year-over-year.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% month-over-month signals increased economic activity, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market sentiment improves.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 70% of the instances where industrial production increased by more than 1% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and a decrease in the unemployment rate signals a strengthening economy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer confidence and spending increase.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increase > 5% in 1 month AND UNRATE decrease > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 60% of the instances where both housing starts increased by more than 5% and the unemployment rate decreased by more than 0.2 percentage points within the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Consumer Price Index by more than 0.5% month-over-month signals inflationary pressure, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the Federal Reserve is expected to tighten monetary policy.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the Consumer Price Index increased by more than 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls by more than 200,000 jobs month-over-month signals a strengthening labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market sentiment improves.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 70% of the instances where nonfarm payrolls increased by more than 200,000 jobs month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in real retail and food services sales and a decrease in the unemployment rate signals a strengthening consumer-driven economy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer confidence and spending increase.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increase > 1% in 1 month AND UNRATE decrease > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 50% of the instances where both real retail and food services sales increased by more than 1% and the unemployment rate decreased by more than 0.2 percentage points within the last month.
